exclusions.source_text: Have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0, 1, or 2
Creatinine CL 60 mL/min by the Cockcroft-Gault formula or by 24-hour urine collection for determination of creatinine CL
Serum bilirubin 1.5 × institutional upper limit of normal (ULN);
AST (serum glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase)/ALT (serum glutamic-pyruvic transaminase) 2.5 × institutional ULN; and
Have a history of CIS or MIBC;
symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia
Are a woman of childbearing potential regardless of contraceptive use
